title: Azusawa Kohane — Warm Camping Style〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Aboard a train

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Man, camping was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It really was!
We had an early start, so it'll be nice to head home for the day and rest.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But we have another hour on this train. What do we do until we arrive?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's true.
On the way there, we could talk about what we'd be doing... What should we do for the way back?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, how about cards...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I brought some with me, but we didn't really have time yesterday. What if we played something now?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, let's do that!
Nice one, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Cards...?
I remember Tsukasa teaching me the rules of some games.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If I recall correctly, I learned how to play Old Maid, President and Sevens...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Tsukasa? Not anyone from his family...? Does that mean he didn't really play many games at home growing up...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
He taught you...?
He didn't teach you anything weird, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, nothing unorthodox as far as I could tell.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Although, he personally liked to strike a pose each time he made a pair. Luckily, he didn't make anyone else do that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So he's always been like that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha!
Then, why don't we start with Old Maid? Mind handing me the cards, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, every card's been dealt out! What order should we go in...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Clockwise, I guess?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! Let's start with you, Kohane! Draw something from my hand!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, let me see what's in my hand first...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh no...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I... I have the joker...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(What do I do...?
I can't let the others find out...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Lemme guess, you got the joker...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Gasp*...!
N-No, what are you talking about...?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (She has it...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's get started.
Take your pick, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right. Um... This one!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, that didn't help...
Even though I have so many cards.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, I'm next.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh no...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Wait, he'll know where the joker is if I keep staring at it. Just play it cool and look away...!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It's like she can't hide what she's thinking...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This one.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, that makes a pair.
I should be done in no time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?! No fair, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito's always had been pretty good at these games. It's as if he can find the exact cards that he needs.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Dude, there's no way I can do that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(N-No...
I'm gonna lose if this keeps up...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: There, I win.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?! A-Already?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That was way too fast! You know this is a game, right? You should be having more fun!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What choice did I have? All I did was avoid what I thought was the joker and voila.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (N-No, I knew this would happen...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So now, Shiraishi, you'll be taking from my hand, and Azusawa will be taking from yours.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay!
Eeny, meeny, miny... Mo!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Drats, another dud...
Oh well. Alright, Kohane, your turn.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
O-Okay.
How about this one...?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wait.. Yay!
That's what I needed!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, good for you!
Hold on... You're down to one card!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That means...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, right... Once you take this from me, Aoyagi, I'm out, right...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You've gotta be kidding me! I was so sure that Toya would never draw the joker...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, Kohane gets second.
You did pretty well for yourself.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Th-Thanks.
I was so worried about what would happen if the joker stayed in my hand, but I'm glad everything worked out...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Now it's just me and you, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're on! There's no way I'm losing this one!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Hehe... I didn't expect to finish so quickly...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh, I should take a photo on my phone while I still have a chance.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'll just move away a bit to get them all in the frame and... Huh?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, why's that one sticking out like that...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tsukasa taught me that it's more of a mental game in these situations.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What, like psychological warfare...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Geez, it's the joker too...
Talk about an old-school tactic.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Hmm...
This has to be the joker...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(But Toya's really smart...
It could be something completely different. What if he just wants me to think it's the joker...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But what if that's his actual strategy? What if he's doing this to make me think that...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Arrgh... My head's starting to hurt!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I can't see Aoyagi's hand from here, but I have to think that's the joker...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Even if it is, he has four other cards. Just in terms of probability, it really just seems better to pick a card other than the one that's sticking out...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (What's An gonna do...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Forget it!
Thinking won't help me at this point!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm going with you, middle card!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane & Akito
rows.Line: That's...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Did I do something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Noooo! I-It's the joker!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hehe. Looks like this battle is mine, Shiraishi...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Y-You monster...!!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And a pair of twos to finish things off...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, I lost...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That became such a heated battle in the end...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, but Toya's poker face gave him the upper hand.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, I got unlucky! That's all!
We're playing again! Right now!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
As you wish, Shiraishi.
I'll be sure to pass the joker to you again.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Grr...!
I'm not losing this time!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, round two it is!
